# A Yeti stomped after exactly 16 steps of falling loses 1 hit point, where a Caveman loses 2: its stomp takes
# 1 * ceil(fallTimer/16), theirs floor(fallTimer/16)+1 (851-3468, docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip
# quirks/yeti-stomp-sixteen-steps. A staged scene (written by wiki-clips --replays from a scene spec,
# docs/wiki-media.md): it boots, loads this custom level from the title's load-level menu (240), and plays the
# scene's inputs from 241, its frame 0. The player (@) on a ledge, a Yeti (y) at the foot of a two-deep hole under
# its edge (a one-deep pocket doesn't hold a monster in), and a Caveman (h) in a hole as deep, the same 7 tiles
# below the platform beside the Yeti's:

# He steps right and hops off the ledge (264), short enough that he comes down the hole onto the Yeti, standing at
# its foot. oPlayer1's step counts fallTimer up on every step he falls (yVel > 0), and the collisions run after it,
# so it's 15 after 284 and 16 at the stomp on 285: the Yeti is stunned (status 98) and goes from 5 hit points to 4.
# Walking off, he'd meet it on the 15th step from a ledge this high and on the 17th (taking 2) from one a tile
# higher: a tile of the drop is about two steps there, so the hop, raising where he starts falling from, is what
# puts the 16th on its head. He bounces onto the platform, runs right and hops off its edge the same way (330), onto
# the Caveman, which hops in its hole (an idle Caveman against a wall does): fallTimer is 15 after 352 and 16 at the
# stomp on 353, and it goes from 3 hit points to 1, floor(16/16)+1 = 2. That 2 is also what shows the stomps see 16,
# not the 15 left from the step before: at 15 the Caveman would lose 1, and the Yeti 1 either way. No heart is lost.
# story: oPlayer1.fallTimer=15@284..284 oYeti.status=98@285..285 oYeti.hp=4@285..285 !oYeti.hp<4
# story: oPlayer1.fallTimer=15@352..352 !oCaveman.hp<3@..352 oCaveman.hp=1@353..353 !plife<4
